entries.description: Compare revisions only within the same session_id.
Use captured_at and cache_age_seconds to judge observation freshness.
Partial means more traversal or unavailable members may remain; it does not imply a value.
Unavailable, read_failed, and excluded are observations, not inferred values.
The runtime category reported for an observed Live object; availability may vary by edition and version.
A captured readable value on an object; interpret it with its capture time, unit metadata, and read outcome.
A named link from one observed object to other object IDs; traverse it with the reported revision and pagination fields.
